The Maids

With Madame away, two maids role play their darkest fantasies about their mistress until performance and reality begin to blur.

Kip Williams follows his international hit production of The Picture of Dorian Gray with this wild reimagining of Jean Genet’s masterpiece set for the digital era. The Donmar’s acclaimed production stars Bridgerton‘s Yerin Ha, House of the Dragon’s Phia Saban, and Olivier Award nominee Lydia Wilson. Running May 17–June 14.
